ticket.subject: Re: Contact sync creating duplicates
ticket.body_text:
Hi Sam Ortega,

Same problem again after your fix. The sync ran at 06:00 and duplicated every contact again; we now have each contact three times. Our sales team cannot work with this list today.

Leila

On Fri, 18 Sep 2026 at 04:20, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
> Good news: our engineers deployed a fix for the duplicate contacts created
> by the nightly sync. You can merge the existing duplicates with the 'Merge
> duplicates' action in Contacts. Please let us know if you see new duplicates
> after tonight's sync.

> On Thu, 17 Sep 2026 at 03:13, Leila Oyelaran wrote:
>> Since Monday, the nightly sync with our CRM creates a second copy of every
>> contact. We have about 4,000 contacts, so this is now 8,000. We did not
>> change anything in the sync settings.

>> On Thu, 17 Sep 2026 at 02:06, Sam Ortega (Support) wrote:
>>> Thanks for reporting this. We can see the extra contacts in your workspace
>>> and have passed it to our engineers. We will update you as soon as we know
>>> more.

label_notes: thread_quoted: a reopened defect for one customer; the sales list is unusable with no workaround = P2; blocked today = high.
